results.title: Car and Driver EV of the Year passage contains Tesla or Cybertruck and the name is highlighted

steps.title: Given the user is on the Action Center of the Tesla analysis
steps.expected: The Target Sources cards are displayed on the ALL tab

steps.title: And the caranddriver.com card is displayed in the list
steps.expected: The card shows the IMPROVE PERCEPTION badge and "Negative perception in N articles"
steps.data: caranddriver.com (#5 on "5 Oct 2026", #11 on "4 Oct 2026")

steps.title: When the user opens the details panel of caranddriver.com
steps.expected: The details panel opens on the right with the header "#N · caranddriver.com", the tab "Negative perception (N)" and the line "Each of these articles mentions Tesla negatively."

steps.title: And the user locates the article "Presenting Car and Driver's 2024 EV of the Year"
steps.expected: The article row shows its title, its URL and a quoted passage in italics
steps.data: URL caranddriver.com/news/a61836993/hyundai-ioniq-5-n-ev-of-the-year-2024/

steps.title: Then the passage contains "Tesla" or "Cybertruck"
steps.expected: The quoted passage contains the word "Tesla" or "Cybertruck" and is no longer "know that the one we rented broke on the second day, effectively parking itself with just a few hundred miles on its odometer."
steps.data: Page sentence: "And before any Tesla loyalists complain that we aren't giving the Cybertruck its due, know that the one we rented broke on the second day, effectively parking itself with just a few hundred miles on its odometer."

steps.title: And the brand or product name is highlighted in the passage
steps.expected: "Tesla" (or "Cybertruck") is shown in bold on a highlight chip inside the passage

results.notes: Tesla, period "5 Oct 2026", AI Engines 3, United States - English. Card #5 caranddriver.com shows IMPROVE PERCEPTION + "Negative perception in 3 articles". Panel header "#5 · caranddriver.com", tab "Negative perception (3)", line "Each of these articles mentions Tesla negatively.". Article "Presenting Car and Driver's 2024 EV of the Year" (caranddriver.com/news/a61836993/hyundai-ioniq-5-n-ev-of-the-year-2024) passage (italic, curly quotes): "into believing the car is burning dinosaur remains. And before any Tesla loyalists complain that we aren't giving the Cybertruck its due," - contains "Tesla" and "Cybertruck", no longer the old name-less text. "Tesla" is rendered in a <mark> chip (font-semibold, not-italic, bg #E0F2FE). "Cybertruck" is not highlighted (only one entity per passage - acceptable, the step says "Tesla" or "Cybertruck"). Note: the criticism "broke on the second day" is no longer in the passage (see TC-006 / OP-4).

results.title: Tesla analysis - no negative passage is missing the brand or product name
results.error: Expected: every quoted passage contains the brand or product name as written on the page. Observed: 1/54 passage fails - consumerreports.org "2021 Tesla Model S Road Test Report" (Source 3 of 29): "RECALL ALERT: There are 24 recalls on this vehicle. [Learn More.](https://www.consumerreports.org/cars/tesla/model-s/2021/reliability/#recal". The only "tesla" is inside a raw markdown link URL (and that URL fragment is what gets highlighted); the article text shown on the page is "RECALL ALERT: There are 24 recalls on this vehicle. Learn More." with no brand name. Related: OP-3, GEO-1202 (raw markdown), GEO-1201 (cut at 140 "#recal").

results.notes: No passage contains a "…" join, so each passage is a single part. Article pages opened in a new tab (all HTTP 200, no paywall). caranddriver.com: "into believing the car is burning dinosaur remains. And before any Tesla loyalists complain that we aren't giving the Cybertruck its due," found exactly (same case, same straight apostrophe). sgbonline.com (Nike): "Stifel’s 2025 All-Star Sneaker Survey Sees Nike Mentions Fall to All-Time Low" found exactly (page headline). birminghammail.co.uk (Lidl, Coco Pops article): "I don't like singling Lidl out, but every time I think they've set the bar at a new low, they somehow find a way of dropping it further. Lid" found exactly as a substring (page continues "Lidl's Choco Rice ..."). The verbatim check passes; the mid-word cut is covered by TC-006 (GEO-1201). Raw markdown passages are covered by TC-008 (GEO-1202).

Known bug: GEO-1202.
